# Ntombis Fashion

> Ntombis Fashion (also known as Ntombis and NTB Fashions) is a bespoke African-inspired fashion house in Rustenburg, North West, South Africa. It designs and makes custom wedding attire, matric dance dresses, traditional and cultural ceremony outfits, event wear and tailored suits, working mostly in shweshwe and Ankara.

## Key facts
- Official name: Ntombis Fashion
- Address: 121 President Mbeki Drive, Rustenburg, North West, 0299, South Africa
- Phone and WhatsApp: 072 340 0477 (+27 72 340 0477)
- Email: info@ntombis.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–14:00, Sunday closed
- How to book: WhatsApp 072 340 0477 or the form at https://www.ntombis.com/contact
- Currency: South African Rand (ZAR)

## What we make
- Wedding attire for brides, grooms and bridal parties
- Matric dance dresses
- Traditional and cultural ceremony outfits, including matching his-and-hers sets
- Event and red-carpet wear
- Tailored suits
- Accessories and jewellery in partnership with Nolty Jewellers
